latHint: Think a classic novel about the Dust Bowl.
pivHint: ANGER isn't just what lasts only a moment, Psalm 30 says. In the classic list of seven deadly sins, this word means the same thing as ANGER.
winText: You found it. ANGER isn't just what lasts a moment — WRATH means the same thing, from the seven deadly sins to Steinbeck's classic novel The Grapes of WRATH.
lossText: The word was WRATH. ANGER was the pivot — WRATH is another word for it, found both in the classic list of seven deadly sins and in the title of Steinbeck's Dust Bowl novel, The Grapes of WRATH.
votdVerse: For his anger lasts only a moment, but his favor lasts a lifetime; weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
passageText: Sing the praises of the Lord, you his faithful people; praise his holy name. For his anger lasts only a moment, but his favor lasts a lifetime; weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
